scope: Policy and robots.txt provenance for the eight configured adapters. These notes describe source statements; they do not establish a research license.

abp.observed: Robots allows general paths and disallows utility/advertising paths. Disclaimer identifies ABP News Network, notes partner/news-agency material, and restricts copying or redistribution absent authorization.
abp.uncertainty: robots policy observed on the English host; language subdomains should be rechecked before future runs.

oneindia.observed: Terms prohibit scraping/automated access and limit content use; robots disallows the general user-agent while allowing named search crawlers with exceptions.
oneindia.uncertainty: Configured transparent project user-agent is not an allowed named search crawler. Collection status must follow Scrapy robots enforcement; do not spoof a search crawler.

amarujala.observed: Terms restrict automated scraping and ML/AI development without prior written consent; robots lists sitemap routes and disallows selected paths.
amarujala.uncertainty: No permission for automated collection or ML use established.

news18.observed: Publisher robots and policy pages could not be inspected by the policy scout; a Network18 disclaimer URL was located but not verified directly.
news18.uncertainty: Access rules and retention terms remain unresolved; do not treat this source as cleared.

loksatta.observed: Terms identify IE Online Media Services and restrict third-party content exploitation; excerpts prohibit automated tools and AI training without written consent. Robots allows general paths with exceptions.
loksatta.uncertainty: No permission for automated collection or ML use established.

handling: Research use is not blanket permission. Preserve attribution and source URLs in the local corpus. Do not redistribute raw article text or images. Respect configured transparent user-agent and robots enforcement; do not bypass restrictions.
